# proctor

A gateway can prove an agent was allowed to call a tool. Proctor prices whether the call was the right one.

Read in this order:

- README.md — the claim, the floor, the limitation
- CONTRACTS.md — classes, weights, tools, splits, arms
- docs/PRE-REGISTRATION.md — frozen protocol
- docs/ETHICS.md — conflict and what data this does not contain
- docs/RED-TEAM.md — how to break the claim
- docs/HANDOFF.md — resume point

`make validate` is the exit condition. It needs no key and no GPU.
The measurement card is `MEASUREMENT_CARD.json` once a run exists.
Verdict `NOT_VERIFIED` names every unmet claim. That state is honest, not a failure.
Seed 999 is the untouched test split. It is never a training seed and never a selection seed.
